source_document: Plan Hidrológico del Guadalete y Barbate 2022–2027, Anejo VI Asignación y reserva de recursos, p. 38 and p. 59 (Zona Gaditana)
notes: The plan supplies the Zona Gaditana (the Consorcio de Aguas de la Zona Gaditana) from the Guadalcacín and Los Hurones reservoirs, Hurones taken first; it does not split the supply between them.
